_readme: Preset store configs. Data, not code: every field is optional, and an unknown store runs the same pipeline with an empty config and a floating badge. Selectors below are UNVERIFIED placeholders until the probe has been run on each store; null means 'use auto-detection'.

_fields.name: display name
_fields.anchor: CSS selector the badge docks after (overrides the detected size control)
_fields.sizeControl: CSS selector of the size picker container, to scope size detection
_fields.reviewPlatform: okendo | yotpo | judgeme | bazaarvoice | powerreviews | stamped | loox | generic
_fields.reviewContainer: CSS selector of the review widget, if auto-detection misses it
_fields.lazyReviews: true to scroll the review widget into view so it loads (scroll position is restored)
_fields.section: force a section (men | women | unisex) when the URL does not say
_fields.returns: curated US online return window: days, what the store counts from (shipping | delivery), the policy page cited in the closet, and when it was checked

brandPriors._readme: Signal rank 7: brand-level offset in size steps (negative = runs small). Hypotheses only; keep empty until there is data. Keys are lowercase alphanumeric brand names, e.g. "abercrombieandfitch": -0.2
